findings.issue_summary: **User-Initiated Collection**: Disclosure exempt, but **must be declared** in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: WearableStreamingService.kt uses AudioRecord (MIC) to capture user voice and transmits it off-device to a first-party server. This is explicitly initiated by the user tapping a microphone button or wearable interaction.
findings.recommendation: Declare audio collection in the Play Store Data Safety form. Prominent disclosure is exempt since the recording is explicitly user-initiated.

findings.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.evidence: FirebaseAnalytics.setAnalyticsCollectionEnabled(true) is called unconditionally in onCreate(), starting telemetry collection before any privacy policy consent.
findings.recommendation: Gate Firebase Analytics initialization behind the has_accepted_privacy_policy flag, similar to Crashlytics.

findings.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.evidence: FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(true) is called unconditionally in MyApplication.onCreate() (line 35), before the gatekeeper AlertDialog in WelcomeScreen can acquire user consent.
findings.recommendation: Remove setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(true) from MyApplication.onCreate() and only enable it after the user taps 'I Agree' in the WelcomeScreen.

findings.issue_summary: App handles user accounts, but the deletion mechanism is a partial deletion trap.
findings.evidence: In /home/shaolin/lyria/shared/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/musically/studio/ui/MainViewModel.kt at line 849 and /home/shaolin/lyria/src/web/features/auth/DeleteAccountScreen.tsx at line 27, the code triggers a standard Firebase auth user deletion but fails to send a remote network API call to clean up the backend user records stored in the Firestore 'users' collection (created in /home/shaolin/lyria/src/routes/auth.ts).
